recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-38630 unless the work group later requests a separate substantive change to profile-specific extension context semantics or tooling behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-38630 was a Published FHIR-core StructureDefinition change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether profile-specific extension context is supported and what StructureDefinition.context.expression should contain, and the approved resolution was to improve discoverability by adding guidance from StructureDefinition.context to defining-extensions.html#context while confirming that profile-specific context should use the element approach.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 081c0d76853720f7011ef5de47560b44fee6638a, which added the requested defining-extensions.html#context link sentence to source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml. Later formatting changed blame attribution, but the substantive FHIR-38630 guidance remains in the current active source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists StructureDefinition as an active resource and assigns it to the FHIR work group. source/hierarchy.xml includes defining-extensions.html, and that page contains the Extension Context table and notes explaining element, extension, and fhirpath contexts, including URL#elementid syntax. FHIR-I minutes on 2022-11-28 record the Persuasive with Modification vote, and the linked Zulip thread explains the original profile-context ambiguity without revealing a later conflicting core-spec decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already carries the applied guidance link on StructureDefinition.context, and the target page contains the profile/context guidance the resolution intended users to find.
